title_zh: 请求解释虚构保单的自动续期条款

scenario.label_zh: 就虚构保险报价条款提出书面询问
scenario.goal_zh: 核对报价与条款疑问并约定转交解释请求、在答复前暂不签署

context_zh: 服务英语角色扮演，使用虚构保险报价。Celia 扮演顾客，Mark 扮演客服；不提供现实保险或法律建议。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: This quote gives an annual premium, but I have a query about the renewal section.

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: The provision about automatic renewal doesn't say whether this quoted price would stay the same.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.text: I'll ask the policy team to explain that in writing. I can't confirm next year's price from this quote.

sentences.speaker: Celia
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll wait for that explanation before signing anything.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.text: Understood. I'll include the renewal section and your price question in the message.
